acquisition_transport.note: MediaFire is byte transport only. The first authoritative run is evidence-discovery only and must persist the archive SHA-256 before any corpus admission is allowed.

certification_stop_line: This config authorizes acquisition and evidence capture only. No WAV receives release-safe corpus credit until the exact ZIP SHA-256 is pinned in this manifest and a later admission change passes source policy, real-byte identity, probe, canonical fingerprint, conservative grouping, global dedup, split and coverage gates.
